body:
severity: error
timestamp: 2026-05-30T21:29:24Z

findings:
Entity-graph is processing every 8-K filing in var/secwatch regardless of whether it contains shareholder vote data. The current batch of 3 AAPL filings (accessions 0000320193-19-000002, -19-000007, -19-000026) all failed with "Item 5.07 not found in filing text". These are 2019-era AAPL 8-Ks that are not proxy-related (no annual meeting vote results).

Result: 3 filings processed, 0 directors extracted, 0 proposals, 0 signals of any type. With 846 total docs in the backlog across 9 tickers, the majority are likely non-proxy 8-Ks (earnings releases, M&A disclosures, officer appointments, etc.) that will never contain Item 5.07. This will produce a high-volume parse error stream and prevent any governance signals from being generated until the actual proxy 8-Ks are reached.

Affected ticker

suggested_fix:
Add a pre-filter in internal/entitygraph/parser.go (or the filing ingestion stage) to skip 8-K filings that do not contain Item 5.07 before attempting full parse. Two options:

1. FAST: In the parser, do a cheap string scan for "5.07" or "Item 5.07" in the raw filing text before running the full extraction. If absent, return a clean skip (not a parse_error) so the gap log stays clean.

2. BETTER:
title: FatBaby obs [error]: entity-graph parsing all 8-K subtypes — Item 5.07 not found in non-proxy filing
